Rowan Cast Iron Co.

Rowan Cast Iron Co. hand-casts iron skillets in Bozeman, Montana. Every skillet is poured, ground, and seasoned three times before it ships, using techniques passed down from three generations of ironworkers in the founder's family. We have been making cookware this way since 1994, selling directly to home cooks who want a skillet that will outlast them.

Our small workshop produces a limited run of skillets each month, which is why we sell directly from our own site rather than through large retailers. Every piece is inspected by hand before it leaves the workshop.
